rotation: Native sensor rotated 180 degrees to upright; all stored pixel coordinates are upright.
camera_source: One CoreMediaIO stream supplies all snapshots and trajectories. The service does not open the controller serial port.
presentation_clock: Native CoreMediaIO presentation timestamps and controller journal monotonic timestamps are on the shared host clock. Color is sampled from the same stream and has its own PTS.
profile_slices: Columns are half-open, divided from the left into eight equal integer widths; any remainder is discarded. Rows 450 through 1289 are sampled on every native frame.
snapshot_service: Loopback endpoint.py asks the sustained stream for a timestamped full-field source or an average over named times. The ring is read without reopening the camera.
